prompt: Name a character from Alice's Adventures in Wonderland or Through the Looking-Glass.

answers.name: Alice
answers.fact: Named for Alice Liddell, who asked Carroll for a story during a rowing trip in 1862.

answers.name: White Rabbit
answers.fact: The first thing Alice sees, checking a pocket watch and fretting about being late.

answers.name: Cheshire Cat
answers.fact: Vanishes by degrees until only the grin is left, which Alice calls the most curious thing she ever saw.

answers.name: Mad Hatter
answers.fact: Never actually called mad in the book — Carroll writes him simply as the Hatter.

answers.name: Queen of Hearts
answers.fact: Orders beheadings constantly. Not one of them is ever carried out.

answers.name: Caterpillar
answers.fact: Sits on a mushroom smoking a hookah and asks Alice who on earth she is.

answers.name: March Hare
answers.fact: Host of the tea party, drawn from the old phrase mad as a March hare.

answers.name: Dormouse
answers.fact: Sleeps through the tea party and is eventually stuffed head-first into the teapot.

answers.name: Humpty Dumpty
answers.fact: In Looking-Glass he explains Jabberwocky to Alice and insists a word means whatever he chooses.

answers.name: Red Queen
answers.fact: From Through the Looking-Glass, not Wonderland — routinely confused with the Queen of Hearts.

answers.name: Tweedledum and Tweedledee
answers.fact: Recite The Walrus and the Carpenter, then agree to have a battle.

answers.name: White Queen
answers.fact: Lives backwards in time and can believe six impossible things before breakfast.

answers.name: Mock Turtle
answers.fact: Weeps through his own story. His name comes from mock turtle soup, which is made with veal.

answers.name: Jabberwock
answers.fact: Appears only inside the poem Alice reads in mirror writing, and is slain with a vorpal sword.

answers.name: Bill the Lizard
answers.fact: Sent down the chimney of the White Rabbit's house and promptly kicked back out of it.
